name: fr.saasradar/saas-radar
title: SaaS Radar
description: Search SaaS Radar, an independent directory of SaaS tools reviewed for French-speaking SMBs.

tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Search the SaaS Radar directory of software reviewed for French-speaking entrepreneurs, freelancers and small businesses. Give a need ('invoicing for freelancers', 'cold email', 'CRM') or a product name, optionally a category slug from list_categories and filters. Returns up to `limit` tools ordered by relevance, each with its tagline, Radar Score (0-10), pricing, GDPR and hosting info, listing `url` and `websiteUrl`. Call get_tool for one tool's full review.

query.description: The need or the product name, in French or English.

category.description: Category slug from list_categories, in the same locale.

free_plan.description: Only tools with a free plan (free or freemium).

eu_hosting.description: Only tools that host data in the European Union.

locale.description: Language of the answer: 'fr' (French, the site's main language) or 'en'. Use 'en' when the user writes in English.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: Full SaaS Radar review of one tool, by slug (from search_tools) or exact name: description, verdict, Radar Score, pros and cons, key features, who it is for and not for, pricing tiers, free plan limits, GDPR, data hosting, vendor, integrations, FAQ and promo code. Includes the listing `url`, a raw Markdown version (`markdownUrl`) and `websiteUrl`.

slug.description: The tool's slug, such as 'lemlist', or its exact name.

locale.description: Language of the answer: 'fr' (French, the site's main language) or 'en'. Use 'en' when the user writes in English.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every SaaS Radar category with at least one published tool: name, slug (to pass to search_tools), number of tools and page URL.

locale.description: Language of the answer: 'fr' (French, the site's main language) or 'en'. Use 'en' when the user writes in English.

tools.name: list_alternatives
tools.description: Alternatives to one tool, as selected by the SaaS Radar editor (not computed), by slug or exact name. Returns the same fields as search_tools. An empty list means no alternatives were validated yet: use search_tools with the tool's category.

slug.description: The tool's slug, such as 'notion', or its exact name.

locale.description: Language of the answer: 'fr' (French, the site's main language) or 'en'. Use 'en' when the user writes in English.
